evals.prompt: Ok the grill is done. Here's what we agreed: we're adding a Stripe webhook handler to an Express/TypeScript app. The handler validates the Stripe signature, identifies the event type, and updates the order status in the DB. Files we're touching: src/middleware/webhookSignature.ts (already has pseudocode), src/webhooks/StripeWebhookController.ts (create), src/services/OrderService.ts (update — add updateStatus method), src/repositories/OrderRepository.ts (update — add findByStripePaymentId and updateStatus). Edge cases: duplicate events must be idempotent (use event ID), invalid signature → 400, unknown event type → log and 200, order not found → log and 200 (don't fail Stripe), DB failure → 500. Break this into tickets.

assertions.text: Tickets are ordered in dependency order — repository before service before controller
Every ticket has a verb-first title
Acceptance criteria reference the specific edge cases from the grill (idempotency, invalid signature, unknown event type, order not found)
Asks the engineer to confirm the breakdown before starting
Each ticket touches no more than 3 files

evals.prompt: We've finished the grill. We're adding JWT authentication to an Express API. Approach: a middleware function that extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header, verifies it using the app secret, and attaches the decoded user to req.user. If valid, calls next(). Files: src/middleware/auth.ts (create), src/types/express.d.ts (update — augment Request with user field), src/routes/index.ts (update — apply middleware to protected routes). Edge cases: missing Authorization header → 401 with 'No token', malformed token → 401 with 'Invalid token', expired token → 401 with 'Token expired', valid token → next() with user on req. Let's break this into tickets.

assertions.text: Type augmentation ticket comes before or is combined with the middleware ticket (types are a dependency)
Routes wiring ticket comes last (depends on middleware existing)
Acceptance criteria include all four edge cases: missing header, malformed token, expired token, valid token
Asks engineer for sign-off before starting Ticket 1
